cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Yes, I'll look after your dog during the kitchen repairs. Bring him over after his walk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He needs to stay overnight too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Absolutely. Stay in my guest room; you can handle breakfast while I sleep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can stay, but his six o'clock walk is your job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll organise it: lead by the door, your alarm at five thirty. You won't have to plan a thing.
